subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: What public reset-start policy should OpenClaw expose for bare `/new` and `/reset` across static acknowledgements, startup/model turns, prompt text, greeting suppression, and optional cheaper greeting-model routing?
rationale: The request adds compatibility-sensitive config and model-routing behavior, so automation should not invent a new key or default without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add One Explicit Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Expose a single typed opt-in policy that covers startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing while preserving current acknowledgement behavior unless maintainers choose otherwise.

options.title: Restore Startup Turns By Default
options.body: Make bare resets run the startup/model turn again and explicitly accept the token-cost, latency, and upgrade behavior change.

options.title: Defer New Reset Controls
options.body: Keep current acknowledgement-only behavior and route prompt customization or startup-turn restoration through the narrower related trackers until the broader policy is approved.

recommendation.title: Add One Explicit Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Expose a single typed opt-in policy that covers startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing while preserving current acknowledgement behavior unless maintainers choose otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current acknowledgement contract and prior policy review, making it the best available owner for the default/config decision.
